notes.title: Hotfixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, our first patch since release is out. Here are the highlights :


[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added tooltip for blood pool
[*] Attack tooltip on enemies should now show correctly
[*] Fixed tooltip of special words on several languages.
[*] "Well Fed" achievement has been changed from Reach 500HP > 200HP 
[*] "Stingy" achievement has been changed from Reach 2000 > 1200 gold
[*] "Baby Steps" achievement was not working properly. This should be fixed now.
[*] Many Hunter enemy skill names that were not showing is added.
[*] Fixed an issue with victory screen buging out if continue button was clicked too fast or spamed and causing save file issues.
[*] Radiance II is now playable.

[/list]



Please keep giving us your feedback, thank you !
